source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 21 (PDF 169-185), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Immunity) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Besides infections, the immune system of vertebrates defends the body against:
(Infections ke ilawa vertebrates ka immune system (mudafati nizam) jism ko kis cheez se bachata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vertebrates ka immune system infections aur cancers dono se bachata hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: To defend against infections and against cancers, vertebrates possess a defence system

blocks.prompt:
2 The chapter names which disease as very dangerous because it weakens the immune system?
(Chapter kis bimari ko bohat khatarnak kehta hai kyun ke yeh immune system ko kamzor karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Immune system ko kamzor karne wali bimariyan, jaise AIDS, bohat khatarnak hain (21.1).

book_ref.quote: That is why, the diseases that weaken the immune system, such as AIDS, are very dangerous

blocks.prompt:
3 Microbial infections, the cause of most human diseases, are invasions of the body by:
(Microbial infections, jo zyada tar insani bimariyon ki wajah hain, jism par kin ke hamle hain?)

options.text: viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi or protists

blocks.explanation: Zyada tar bimariyan microbial infections se hoti hain: viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi ya protists ka hamla (21.1).

book_ref.quote: invasions of the body by viruses, pathogenic bacteria, fungi, or protists

blocks.prompt:
4 Which of the following is NOT a part of the first line of defence?
(In mein se kaun si cheez pehli line of defence (pehli mudafati qatar) ka hissa NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli line skin, digestive tract aur respiratory tract hai; inflammation doosri line ka hissa hai (21.1, 21.2).

book_ref.quote: The first line of defence against infections consists of skin

blocks.prompt:
5 The epidermis of human skin is how many cells thick?
(Insani skin ki epidermis kitne cells moti hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Skin ki epidermis 10 se 30 cells moti hoti hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The epidermis of skin is 10 to 30 cells thick.

blocks.prompt:
6 The outer layer of the epidermis, whose cells are continuously shed, is called:
(Epidermis ki bahar wali tah jis ke cells musalsal jharte rehte hain, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epidermis ki bahar wali tah stratum corneum hai; is ke cells musalsal jharte hain (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The outer layer of epidermis is called stratum corneum.

blocks.prompt:
7 The cells of the stratum corneum are continuously shed because they are:
(Stratum corneum ke cells musalsal kyun jharte hain?)

options.text: natural killer cells un par hamla karte hain
lysozyme unhein hazam kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh cells is liye jharte hain ke musalsal kharab (damage) hote rehte hain (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Its cells are continuously shed, because they are continuously damaged.

blocks.prompt:
8 New skin cells that replace the worn-out cells are formed in the:
(Ghise hue cells ki jagah lene wale naye skin cells kahan bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Naye cells gehri epidermis mein bante hain, upar aate hain aur purane cells ki jagah lete hain (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: New cells are formed in the deep epidermis from where they migrate upward

blocks.prompt:
9 The protein that makes the skin tough and impenetrable for microbes is:
(Woh protein jo skin ko sakht aur microbes ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar banata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Skin ke cells keratin protein banate hain jo skin ko sakht aur microbes ke liye band banata hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: These cells form keratin protein which makes the skin tough and impenetrable for microbes.

blocks.prompt:
10 Oil and sweat glands lower the pH at the skin's surface to:
(Oil aur sweat glands skin ki satah ka pH kitna kar dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oil aur paseene ke glands skin ka pH 3-5 kar dete hain; yeh tezabiyat bohat se microbes ko rokti hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The oil and sweat glands present in skin lower the pH

blocks.prompt:
11 The lysozyme present in sweat acts on:
(Paseene mein mojood lysozyme kis par asar karta hai?)

options.text: bohat se bacteria ki cell walls

blocks.explanation: Paseene mein lysozyme hota hai jo bohat se bacteria ki cell walls ko torta aur hazam karta hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Sweat also contains the enzyme lysozyme, which attacks and digests the cell walls of many bacteria.

blocks.prompt:
12 In an adult human, skin makes up what percentage of the total body weight?
(Baligh insan mein skin jism ke kul wazan ka kitna feesad hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Skin sab se bara organ hai; baligh insan mein kul wazan ka 15% skin hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: In an adult human, 15% of the total weight is skin.

blocks.prompt:
13 The largest organ of the vertebrate body is the:
(Vertebrate jism ka sab se bara organ kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Skin vertebrate jism ka sab se bara organ hai (21.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Skin is the largest organ of the vertebrate body.

blocks.text: 21.1.2 Defence Provided by Digestive and Respiratory Tracts

blocks.prompt:
14 Most bacteria present in the food we eat are killed in the oral cavity by:
(Khane mein mojood zyada tar bacteria munh (oral cavity) mein kis se marte hain?)

options.text: saliva (thook), jis mein lysozyme hota hai

blocks.explanation: Khane ke zyada tar bacteria munh mein saliva (thook) se marte hain jis mein lysozyme hota hai (21.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Most of these are killed by saliva in the oral cavity, which also contains lysozyme.

blocks.prompt:
15 In the intestine, bacteria in food are killed by:
(Intestine (aant) mein khane ke bacteria kis se marte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Maeday ke tez acids aur aant ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes bhi bacteria marte hain (21.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The strong digestive acids present in the stomach and the protein-digesting enzymes

blocks.prompt:
16 Many bacteria in the air are trapped, before they enter the air passageway, by ciliated epithelial cells in the:
(Hawa ke bohat se bacteria hawa ki naali mein dakhil hone se pehle kahan ke ciliated epithelial cells mein phans jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nasal cavity (naak) ke ciliated epithelial cells bohat se bacteria ko hawa ki naali se pehle hi pakar lete hain (21.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Ciliated epithelial cells in the nasal cavity trap many bacteria

blocks.prompt:
17 The sticky secretion of cells lining the smaller bronchi and bronchioles, which traps microbes, is:
(Chhoti bronchi aur bronchioles ke cells ki chipchipi ratoobat jo microbes ko pakarti hai, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh cells chipchipa mucus banate hain jo microbes ko lungs tak pohanchne se pehle pakar leta hai (21.1.2; sahi lafz mucus hai).

book_ref.quote: The cells lining the smaller bronchi and bronchioles secrete a layer of sticky

blocks.prompt:
18 The mucus with trapped microbes is swept upward by cilia, where it:
(Microbes wala mucus cilia upar ki taraf dhakelte hain, phir us ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: khoon mein jazb ho jata hai
bronchioles mein hazam ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Cilia mucus ko musalsal upar dhakelte hain jahan woh nigla ja sakta hai (21.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Cilia on the cells lining these passages continually sweep

blocks.prompt:
19 The second line of defence comes into play when invaders:
(Doosri line of defence kab harkat mein aati hai?)

options.text: pehli line ko paar karke gehre tissues tak pohanch jayein

blocks.explanation: Jab hamla awar pehli line ko paar karke gehre tissues tak pohanch jayein to doosri line kaam karti hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: When such invaders reach deep tissues, a second line of defence comes into play.

blocks.prompt:
20 Along with the first line, the second line of defence is categorized as:
(Pehli line ke saath doosri line of defence ko kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli line ki tarah doosri line bhi non-specific (ghair makhsoos) defence hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Along with the first line of defence, the second line is also categorized as a non-specific defence.

blocks.prompt:
21 Which of these is NOT one of the four most important devices of the second line of defence?
(In mein se kaun doosri line ke chaar sab se aham tareeqon mein se NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar yeh hain: khoon ke germ-killer cells, antimicrobial proteins, inflammatory response aur temperature response; antibodies teesri line ka hissa hain (21.2).

book_ref.quote: The four most important of these are; the germ-killer cells of blood

blocks.prompt:
22 The most important non-specific defence is provided by:
(Sab se aham non-specific defence kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se aham non-specific defence khoon ke germ-killer cells dete hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The most important non-specific defence is provided by the germ-killer cell of the blood.

blocks.prompt:
23 Which of the following is NOT one of the three basic kinds of germ-killer cells of blood?
(In mein se kaun khoon ke germ-killer cells ki teen bunyadi qismon mein se NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen qismein macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells hain (21.2.1); plasma cells B cells se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: There are three basic kinds: macrophages, neutrophils, and natural killer cells.

blocks.prompt:
24 Macrophages develop from:
(Macrophages kis se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Macrophages monocytes se bante hain jo safaid khoon ke cells ki aik qisam hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Macrophages develop from monocytes (a type of white blood cells).

blocks.prompt:
25 A macrophage takes in a bacterium by:
(Macrophage bacterium ko kis tareeqe se andar leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Macrophage bacterium ko endocytosis se nigalta hai aur lysozyme enzymes se maar deta hai (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: A macrophage ingests a bacterium, by endocytosis

blocks.prompt:
26 Fixed macrophages are found in all of these organs EXCEPT:
(Fixed macrophages in sab organs mein hote hain SIWAYE:)
blocks.explanation: Kuch macrophages lungs, liver, spleen aur brain mein fixed hote hain (21.2.1); heart in mein shamil nahi.

book_ref.quote: Some macrophages are fixed within some organs e.g., lungs, liver, spleen, and brain.

blocks.prompt:
27 Most macrophages:
(Zyada tar macrophages kya karte hain?)

options.text: khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid mein gasht karte hain
bone marrow ke andar rehte hain

blocks.explanation: Zyada tar macrophages khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid mein gasht karte hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: But most of them patrol in the blood, lymph and interstitial fluid.

blocks.prompt:
28 The network of DNA fibres released by neutrophils:
(Neutrophils ka chhora hua DNA fibres ka jaal kya karta hai?)

options.text: virus wale cells ki membrane mein surakh karta hai
jism ka darja hararat barhata hai
bimari wale bacteria se jur kar unhein maar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Teesre tareeqe mein neutrophils DNA fibres ka jaal chhorte hain jo bacteria se chipak kar unhein maar deta hai (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: These fibres bind with pathogenic bacteria and kill them.

blocks.prompt:
29 In their second method of killing pathogens, neutrophils release:
(Pathogens marne ke doosre tareeqe mein neutrophils kya chhorte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Doosre tareeqe mein neutrophils pathogens par hal hone wale anti-microbial chemicals chhorte hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: In the second method, they release soluble anti-microbial chemicals on pathogens.

blocks.prompt:
30 Natural killer cells attack:
(Natural killer cells kis par hamla karte hain?)

options.text: virus se infected jism ke cells

blocks.explanation: NK cells khud microbes ko nahi marte; woh virus se infected jism ke cells ko pehchan kar un par hamla karte hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: They do not kill invading microbes, rather they detect and attack the body cells

blocks.prompt:
31 The special proteins released by natural killer cells that insert into the target cell membrane are:
(Natural killer cells ke woh khaas proteins jo target cell ki membrane mein ghus jate hain:)
blocks.explanation: NK cells perforins chhorte hain jo target cell ki membrane mein ghus kar surakh banate hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: They release special proteins, called perforins

blocks.prompt:
32 A target cell attacked by a natural killer cell dies because:
(Natural killer cell ke hamle se target cell kyun mar jata hai?)

options.text: lysozyme us ka DNA kaat deta hai
woh endocytosis se nigla jata hai
surakh se paani andar aata hai aur cell phool kar phat jata hai
us ki cell wall hazam ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Perforin ka surakh paani ko andar aane deta hai, cell phool kar phat jata hai (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This pore allows water to rush into the target cell, which then swells and bursts.

blocks.prompt:
33 Natural killer cells kill cancer cells before they:
(Natural killer cells cancer cells ko kis se pehle maar dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: NK cells cancer cells ko pehchan kar tumour (rasoli) banne se pehle maar dete hain (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: They are also able to detect cancer cells

blocks.prompt:
34 According to the corrected fact in this topic, natural killer cells are:
(Is topic ki durust baat ke mutabiq natural killer cells kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: NK cells innate (paidaishi) defence ke lymphocytes hain; yeh T cells ya cytotoxic T cells nahi (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: In fact NK cells are lymphocytes of the innate (non-specific) defence

blocks.prompt:
35 The patrolling germ-killer cells do not attack normal body cells because these cells carry a surface marker called:
(Gasht karne wale germ-killer cells jism ke normal cells par hamla kyun nahi karte? Un par kaun sa marker hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ke tamam normal cells par self-protein marker hota hai; germ-killer cells sirf un cells par hamla karte hain jin par yeh nahi (21.2.1).

book_ref.quote: This protein is called self-protein.

blocks.prompt:
36 The two main groups of protective proteins of the non-specific defence are:
(Non-specific defence ke protective proteins ke do bare groups kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Protective proteins complement system proteins aur interferons hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Two main groups of proteins participate in the non-specific defence of the body.

blocks.prompt:
37 The proteins of the complement system are produced in the:
(Complement system ke proteins kahan bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Complement system ke proteins liver (jigar) mein bante hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Special proteins produced in the liver make the complement system of proteins.

blocks.prompt:
38 The complement system consists of:
(Complement system kitne proteins par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Complement system darjan se zyada mukhtalif proteins par mushtamil hai jo ghair fa'al halat mein ghoomte hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: This system consists of more than a dozen different proteins

blocks.prompt:
39 When complement proteins encounter a microbe, they become active:
(Microbe se saamna hone par complement proteins kaise fa'al hote hain?)

options.text: silsilay se, pehla doosre ko fa'al karta hai
sirf bukhar shuru hone ke baad

blocks.explanation: Yeh silsilay se fa'al hote hain: pehla protein doosre ko fa'al karta hai, phir aage (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: When they encounter a microbe, they become active in a sequence.

blocks.prompt:
40 The membrane-attack complex (MAC) is formed by:
(Membrane-attack complex (MAC) kaun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri paanch complement proteins microbe ki membrane mein MAC banate hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The final five proteins form a membrane-attack complex (MAC)

blocks.prompt:
41 After the membrane-attack complex punctures a microbe's membrane:
(MAC microbe ki membrane mein surakh kar de to phir kya hota hai?)

options.text: microbe sikur kar sookh jata hai
microbe par keratin chadh jata hai
fluids aur namak andar jate hain, microbe phool kar phat jata hai
microbe tezi se taqseem hota hai

blocks.explanation: Fluids aur namkiyat andar jate hain, microbe phool kar phat jata hai (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: So, fluids and salts move inside microbe resulting in its swelling and bursting.

blocks.prompt:
42 Interferons are released by:
(Interferons kaun chhorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Interferons virus se infected cells chhorte hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: They are released by virus-infected cells.

blocks.prompt:
43 Interferons released by a virus-infected cell cause nearby cells to:
(Interferons qareebi cells par kya asar karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interferons qareebi cells ko apna anti-viral bachao barhane par uksate hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: They cause nearby cells to enhance their anti-viral defences.

blocks.prompt:
44 Interferons belong to the large class of proteins called:
(Interferons proteins ki kis bari class se talluq rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interferons cytokines ki class se hain jo cells ke darmiyan rabtay ka kaam karte hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Interferons belong to the large class of proteins known as cytokines.

blocks.prompt:
45 Besides alerting nearby cells, interferons also activate:
(Qareebi cells ko khabardar karne ke ilawa interferons kin ko fa'al karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interferons natural killer cells aur macrophages ko bhi fa'al karte hain (21.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Interferons also activate other immune cells, such as natural killer cells and macrophages.

blocks.prompt:
46 The chemical signals released by injured or infected cells cause the local blood vessels to:
(Zakhmi ya infected cells ke chemical signals maqami khoon ki naaliyon par kya asar karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Histamines aur prostaglandins maqami khoon ki naaliyan phaila dete hain, capillary mein khoon ka bahao barhta hai (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: These chemicals cause local expansion of blood vessels.

blocks.prompt:
47 During the inflammatory response, the capillaries at the site become:
(Inflammatory response mein capillaries kaisi ho jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Capillaries zyada permeable (guzarne dene wali) ho jati hain (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The capillaries also become more permeable.

blocks.prompt:
48 The signs of inflammation at the spot of injury or infection are:
(Zakhm ya infection ki jagah inflammation ki alamaat kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ka zyada bahao aur permeability surkhi, soojan aur garmi paida karte hain; yahi inflammation hai (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: It results in redness, swelling and warmth at the spot.

blocks.prompt:
49 The heat at an inflamed site:
(Inflamed jagah ki garmi kya karti hai?)

options.text: microbes ko tezi se barhne deti hai
WBCs ki harkat rok deti hai
jagah ko microbes ke barhne ke liye na-munasib banati hai

blocks.explanation: Garmi jagah ko microbes ke liye na-munasib banati hai, shifa barhati hai aur WBCs ki harkat tez karti hai (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The heat makes the site unfavourable for microbial growth.

blocks.prompt:
50 The phagocytes that migrate from blood to the inflamed tissue to engulf microbes are:
(Kaun se phagocytes khoon se inflamed tissue mein ja kar microbes nigalte hain?)

options.text: surkh khoon ke cells aur platelets

blocks.explanation: Zyada phagocytes (macrophages aur neutrophils) inflamed tissue mein ja kar microbes nigalte hain (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: More phagocytes (macrophages and neutrophils) migrate from the blood to the inflamed tissue

blocks.prompt:
51 In the inflammatory response, dead microbes, cells and debris are cleaned up by:
(Inflammatory response mein murda microbes, cells aur malbe ki safai kaun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monocytes aa kar microbes marne wale chemicals chhorte hain, phir macrophages safai karte hain (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: then macrophages clean up dead microbes, cells, and debris

blocks.prompt:
52 Pus associated with some infections is a mixture of:
(Kuch infections mein banne wali peep (pus) kis cheez ka murakkab hai?)

options.text: murda ya marte neutrophils, toote tissue cells aur murda pathogens

blocks.explanation: Peep murda ya marte neutrophils, toote hue tissue cells aur murda pathogens ka murakkab hai (21.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The pus associated with some infections is a mixture of dead or dying neutrophils

blocks.prompt:
53 Pyrogens act on the part of the brain that is the body's thermostat, the:
(Pyrogens dimagh ke us hisse par asar karte hain jo jism ka thermostat hai:)
blocks.explanation: Pyrogens khoon ke zariye dimagh ke hypothalamus tak pohanchte hain jo jism ka thermostat hai (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: The pyrogens pass through the bloodstream to the brain and reach the hypothalamus.

blocks.prompt:
54 The normal value of the body's core temperature, above which pyrogens raise it, is:
(Jism ke andaruni darja hararat ki normal qeemat, jis se upar pyrogens usay le jate hain:)
blocks.explanation: Pyrogens hypothalamus ko uksa kar darja hararat normal 37 °C (98.6 °F) se upar le jate hain (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Here, the pyrogens stimulate the hypothalamus to boost the body

blocks.prompt:
55 Another name for fever is:
(Bukhar (fever) ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Normal se zyada darja hararat ko fever (pyrexia) kehte hain (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: The higher-than-normal temperature is known as fever (pyrexia).

blocks.prompt:
56 Fever acts as a defence mechanism because it:
(Bukhar defence ka tareeqa kyun hai?)

options.text: bacteria aur viruses ki nasal barhane ki salahiyat rokta hai
interferons ka banna band karta hai
skin ka keratin ghol deta hai

blocks.explanation: Bukhar bacteria aur viruses ki nasal barhane ki salahiyat ko rokta hai (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: It hinders the ability of bacteria and viruses to reproduce.

blocks.prompt:
57 Which of these is named in the chapter as a temperature-sensitive microbe killed at high fever?
(Chapter mein kaun sa microbe temperature-sensitive bataya gaya hai jo tez bukhar mein mar jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch microbes, jaise Streptococcus pneumoniae aur influenza, tez bukhar mein mar jate hain (21.2.4; sahi naam pneumoniae).

book_ref.quote: are temperature-sensitive and are killed at high fever

blocks.prompt:
58 During fever, the actions of which cells become faster?
(Bukhar ke dauran kin cells ka amal tez ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bukhar neutrophils aur macrophages ke amal ki raftar barhata hai (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Fever also enhances the speed of the actions of neutrophils and macrophages.

blocks.prompt:
59 Body temperatures greater than which value are often fatal?
(Kis qeemat se zyada darja hararat aksar jaan leva hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 103 °F (39.4 °C) se zyada khatarnak aur 105 °F (40.5 °C) se zyada aksar jaan leva hai (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: and those greater than 105

blocks.prompt:
60 During fever, the body releases more:
(Bukhar ke dauran jism kya zyada chhorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bukhar mein jism zyada cytokines (interferons) chhorta hai (21.2.4).

book_ref.quote: During fever, the body releases more cytokines (interferons).

blocks.prompt:
61 The third line of defence is called specific because it:
(Teesri line of defence ko specific kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: har germ ke khilaf aik jaisa kaam karti hai
sirf bukhar se kaam karti hai
makhsoos germs ko nishana bana kar khaas un ke khilaf kaam karti hai

blocks.explanation: Teesri line makhsoos germs ko nishana banati hai aur khaas un ke khilaf kaam karti hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: It is the specific defence, which means that it targets specific germs

blocks.prompt:
62 A feature of the third line of defence that the first two lines lack is that it:
(Teesri line ki aik khoobi jo pehli do lines mein nahi:)

options.text: maeday ke acid se kaam karti hai
purane hamla awaron ko yaad rakh kar tezi se jawab deti hai
cilia aur mucus istemal karti hai

blocks.explanation: Immune system purane hamla awaron ko yaad rakhta hai aur dobara aane par tezi se jawab deta hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: can remember previous invaders and responds quickly if they enter the body again

blocks.prompt:
63 The non-specific defence present at birth is also called:
(Paidaish se mojood non-specific defence ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Non-specific defence paidaish se hota hai, is liye isay innate (paidaishi) immunity kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: So, it is also called inborn or innate immunity.

blocks.prompt:
64 The specific defence that develops during growth is called:
(Barhne ke dauran hasil hone wala specific defence kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Specific defence barhne ke dauran hasil hota hai, isay acquired (hasil karda) immunity kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: While the specific defence is acquired during growth and it is called acquired immunity.

blocks.prompt:
65 In passive immunity:
(Passive immunity mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: insan ko makhsoos microbes ke khilaf antibodies di jati hain
kamzor antigens inject kiye jate hain
skin ka pH kam kiya jata hai

blocks.explanation: Passive immunity mein insan ko bani banai antibodies di jati hain; yeh kam muddat ki hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: While, in passive immunity, the individual is given antibodies to combat specific microbes.

blocks.prompt:
66 The most effective form of immunity is:
(Immunity ki sab se moassar qisam kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Natural active immunity mein jism antigens se saamne par khud antibodies banata hai; yeh sab se moassar hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the most effective form of immunity.

blocks.prompt:
67 Artificial active immunity is achieved by:
(Artificial active immunity kaise hasil hoti hai?)

options.text: jism ka darja hararat barha kar

blocks.explanation: Artificial active immunity kamzor antigens de kar (vaccination) hasil hoti hai jo jism ko antibodies banane par uksate hain.
